snippet.title: Traveler - Kickstarter Trailer
snippet.description:
Want more? https://traveler-game.com/

Traveler is an parry-based Metroidvania, 2d platformer with fairy-tale themes.

The game's plan is to be released on Steam, Nintendo Switch, PlayStation and Xbox.

Website → https://traveler-game.com/
Twitter → https://twitter.com/UDFTStudios
Steam → https://store.steampowered.com/app/2292520/Traveler/
Kickstarter → https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/travelergame/traveler-a-cute-metroidvania-puzzle-platformer
